feat(p4-1): qualify inaugural baseline and isolate rehearsal bucket

Add an explicit non-formal, immutable, approved bootstrap-source path without
falling back from ordinary formal Release lookup. Preserve three-asset byte
verification, exact promotion replay, all production gates and old Trace.

Retain qualified real GCC originals, actual local red/green tests and source
provenance. Keep OTA-DEC-017 proposed and formal execution unadmitted pending
authorized integration. This is a development candidate, not a rehearsal.
